title: Halal Fresh: which site? Case and justify frame
subject: Business
unit: Spring 1: The international economy and government (1.5, 1.6)
source: Written for business/y10 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Halal Fresh site case and justify frame)
intro: Lesson 14. Read the case and the data, then justify your choice.

passage.title: Halal Fresh Ltd
paras: Halal Fresh is a halal meat wholesaler. It buys meat from farms and abattoirs and delivers it, chilled, to about 60 restaurants and takeaways across the region, six days a week. Most orders are placed by phone or online the night before.
Its lease is ending and it must move. It has found two sites.
passage.source: All businesses, people and figures in this case are fictional, made up for practice.

roads: Ring road (25 min at rush hour)

blocks.text: Justify which site Halal Fresh should choose. (9 marks)

frame.label: Because (use the data)
frame.prompt: Give a reason and develop it into a chain, using figures from the case.

frame.label: However (the other option)
frame.prompt: Give the strongest point for the other option and develop it.

frame.label: Overall, why my choice beats it
frame.prompt: Compare the two: why your option is better for THIS business.

markScheme.q: Justify Site A or Site B (9)
markScheme.a: Most likely Site B: Halal Fresh delivers to restaurants, so motorway access and a loading bay matter more than passing trade; rent is £26,000 a year lower; space for a cold store keeps meat safe. Against: staff travel is harder (one bus an hour). Site A only if justified (e.g. adding a shop for the public). Level 3 (7-9): a justified choice that uses the data, with developed chains of reasoning and a comparison showing why it beats the other option. Level 2 (4-6): reasons for the choice in context but little comparison. Level 1 (1-3): generic points.
